note: Primary: Croteam's Steam post 'Price Adjustment for The Talos Principle 2' (28 Oct 22:01Z): base price $29.99 to $39.99, regional prices adjusted, rising development and support costs and inflation, owners unaffected. Steam store read 13:30Z: US $39.99, AE 119.99 AED, SA 86.99 SR. Sound: Release Date trailer music from 3.9 s (no speech; the launch and gameplay trailers are narrated throughout). Pictures: Release Date trailer robot face, launch trailer robots.
